ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Adani Ports and Special Economic Zone Limited (APSEZL) will conduct a "Non-Deal Roadshow" in the USA from August 24-28, 2026, to engage with institutional investors and analysts, as per SEBI regulations. This proactive investor outreach aims to disseminate company information and foster investor relationships, indicating a standard corporate investor relations activity. There are no immediate material financial impacts or apparent red flags from this scheduled interaction, given its "Non-Deal" nature.
